author: CNN
description:
Russian authorities have sought to allay global worries over the death of a young woman who worked at a Siberian anti-plague laboratory. But moves to isolate her contacts and introduce new disease-control measures at local hospitals have raised concerns among people who fear they’re not being told the full story. 

The United States has made a formal request to Russia for information and US President Donald Trump said he is expecting to speak to his counterpart Vladimir Putin about the issue. The Kremlin on Wednesday said no call had been arranged between the two leaders but could be arranged, if requested. 

CNN’s Fred Pleitgen has the latest details on Russia’s response in the face of increased international scrutiny. Also, Professor Joseph Allen of Harvard University School of Public Health and infectious disease specialist and epidemiologist Dr. Celine Gounder share their concerns. 

0:00 Trump schedules call with Putin as Russia continues to downplay lab death 
2:57 Harvard profe
title: Trump admin wants answers from Russia on potential plague death

description:
Officials in California denounced comments made by President Donald Trump as “dangerous” after he appeared to suggest Iran could “take out” Los Angeles or San Diego — major cities in a state he has often criticized. 

Speaking at a rally in Grand Island, Nebraska, ahead of the midterm elections, Trump once again called the consequences of the war with Iran a “small price to pay for keeping the world safe, keeping our country safe,” adding that Iran could potentially take out an American city. 

CNN’s Kaitlan Collins has more and CNN’s Anderson Cooper gets reactions from Republican strategist David Urban and Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass. 

0:00 Anderson Cooper details recent instances of Trump being “loose with his language” 
2:47 CNN’s Kaitlan Collins covers the White House response to Trump’s controversial comment about LA and Sand Diego 
5:04 GOP strategist reacts to Trump’s remarks 
5:48 LA Mayor Karen Bass explains why she doesn’t believe the White House explanation 

Watch 24/7 l
